description: Swiss Style 기반 날카로운 미니멀 랜딩페이지. 여백·타이포그래피·그리드만으로 완성되는 건축적 디자인. 이미지 없이 CSS만으로 고급스러운 비주얼 완성.
design_spec_raw:
# DESIGN SPEC: Sharp-Edged Minimalism Landing Page # Style: Refined Minimal — Swiss Style / Bauhaus inspired # NO external images required — CSS only ## Global Design Settings Tone: Professional, architectural, sharp-edged minimalism Color Palette: Base background: #E9E9E9 (light gray) or #FFFFFF (white) Text: #000000 (jet black) or #333333 (dark gray) Accent: #000000 (black) — used for bold lines and emphasized text Dark sections: #111111 background with #FFFFFF text — for high-impact areas Divider lines: 1px solid #000 or 2px solid #000 Typography: Headings: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial — ultra-bold, decoratively positioned Body: Inter or system-ui — small size, generous letter-spacing (0.05em), line-height 1.8 Numbers: Large Western type for emphasis (e.g., 01, 02, 03 or statistical figures) Section labels: uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2em, small font-size (0.75rem) Layout Rules: - Use strict grid system (CSS Grid) - Place section number + title label top-left of every section (e.g., '01. INTRODUCTION') - Intentionally leave large empty areas (negative space) — luxury feeling - NO rounded corners — all elements use sharp 0px border-radius - Thin black divider lines between sections (1px) - Mobile responsive (stack to single column on mobile) ## Page Structure (6 Sections) ### Section 1: HERO — Title Typography - Massive headline text (font-size: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 10rem)) positioned asymmetrically (NOT centered) - Small section label top-left: '01. CONCEPT' - Subtitle ultra-small (0.9rem) positioned as contrast - One-word or short-phrase main title — visual anchor - Thin horizontal rule (1px black) below - Background: white #FFFFFF ### Section 2: INTRODUCTION — Text + Data Emphasis - Asymmetrical 2-column layout (CSS Grid: 1fr 2fr) - Left: oversized bold number or key stat (font-size: 6rem, color: #000) - Right: paragraph text with generous line-height - Section label: '02. ABOUT' - Thin vertical divider line between columns ### Section 3: FEATURES — 3-Step Columns - 3-column grid layout - Each column: large number pillar (01, 02, 03) at top — font-size 3rem, bold - Below number: bold title (1.1rem) - Below title: description text (0.9rem, color: #555) - NO icons — typography contrast only - Thick top border on each column (3px solid #000) - Section label: '03. FEATURES' ### Section 4: STATEMENT — Dark Mode Full Width - Full-width dark background (#111111) - White text - Single large statement sentence (font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem)) - Positioned off-center or asymmetrically - No other elements — pure negative space - Section label: '04. STATEMENT' in small white text top-left ### Section 5: DETAILS — Two Column Split - 50:50 grid split with thick center divider (2px solid #000) - Left column: 'PROBLEM' — dark gray background (#333), white text - Right column: 'SOLUTION' — white background, black text - Each side: bold heading + 3-4 bullet points - Section label: '05. OVERVIEW' ### Section 6: CONTACT — Centered Dark Mode CTA - Dark background (#111111) full-width - White text, centered - Large email or contact link - Minimal CTA button: white border, transparent background, white text - Hover: white background, black text (CSS transition) - Section label: '06. CONTACT' in small white text top-left ## CSS Rules - Google Fonts: @import Inter from Google Fonts (ALLOWED) - All transitions: 0.2s ease - Hover on links: opacity 0.7 - No box-shadows (clean, flat aesthetic) - Padding: generous (section padding: 8rem 2rem on desktop, 4rem 1.5rem on mobile) - Max-width container: 1200px, margin: 0 auto - Each section gets a data-section attribute for accessibility ## Edit Comments (REQUIRED in output HTML) Every editable text area MUST have a comment: Example:
